title: What counts as a substantive exchange
content: An exchange is substantive when it carried a decision, a question, a commitment, or a document — something a reader would need to know to pick the conversation back up. Scheduling replies, acknowledgements, out-of-office notices, and CC-only traffic the user never answered are not substantive, however recent. The most recent substantive exchange is what a brief cites, not the most recent message.

title: Meeting prep reads; it never writes to the calendar
content: The workflow reads the calendar and mailbox to assemble a brief and sends that brief to the user. It does not accept or decline invitations, move or cancel meetings, add attendees, or reply to anyone on the user's behalf. Every action it takes is addressed to the user alone.
